Title: Tactics Tuesdays: Self- vs. Other-Pointing | Girls Chase
content:
Pointing at yourself or others as you set emotional frames anchors those emotions to the pointee. Can you use this in seduction? You absolutely can…

A recent study examined US President Donald Trump’s use of pointing to connect with his audience. The study authors note

Results show that (i) inward points are associated with first-person references; (ii) outward points are associated with second person and third person/object references; (iii) downward points are associated with locative expressions; (iv) looping marks plurality and inclusiveness and (v) internal complexity is associated with expressions of number, time, sequence and comparison.

The authors further note that “Trump uses pointing in the kinesic performance of right-wing populism to entertain his audience, to engage with them more directly, to steer their attention and to align himself with them as a man of the people.”

While academia may just be catching up, the use of pointing has been with us since before we were human (apes, for instance, are known to point).

And one place we’ve long paid attention to the usefulness of the point is in neurolinguistics programming.

 

NLP and Pointing

In neurolinguistics programming (NLP), pointing is used to anchor emotions to specific targets.

As a very basic example, if I say to you that, “You have been very bad,” while pointing at you, you are going to tend to feel much more singled out than if I say, “You have been very bad,” but do not point at you. The addition of the nonverbal element (i.e., pointing right at you) amplifies the message and strengthens the emotional impact. You feel much more harshly judged when I point at you than when I don’t – even if my words, facial expression, tone of voice, and all my other body language is the same.

NLP uses a few core pointer motions, including:

Self-point: when the speaker points at himself.

Other point: when the speaker points at someone else (such as his listener or another party).

The study I referenced at the start of the article also mentions downward pointing to reference a location (“Here, today”) and gestural loops to communicate inclusiveness or multiples of something (“We’re all in this together”).

Because of the way we anchor emotions to targets, pointing at something serves a purpose of telling your viewer and listener where to anchor the emotion you create.

So for instance, if we’re talking and I say something about “very successful people” and at the same time gesture toward myself, your subconscious mind will form an association between “very successful person” and me, Chase Amante. If I then say “people who want more success” and gesture in your direction, you will feel the emotion anchoring to yourself of “I am someone who wants more success.” I can repeat this gestural anchoring more times as we converse and further strengthen the emotional anchor.

This might sound minor, but in fact it is a very powerful tactic. Human interpersonal liking and communication relies primarily on body language. Because our brains contain mirror neurons, when we see someone do something our brains internally model the action, strengthening the pathways between that emotion and its target in the brain. When I point to myself while stating something, you internally point to me too as I state that thing. When I point at you while stating something else, you internally also point at yourself as I state that other thing.

As PsyPost notes

Outward pointing created a dynamic of direct engagement, drawing the audience into the conversation while also enabling Trump to physically single out targets for praise, criticism, or ridicule.

Conversely, inward pointing, directed towards Trump’s own body, was strongly associated with first-person singular pronouns (“I,” “me,” “my”). This occurred particularly when Trump was emphasizing his personal qualities, his commitment to his supporters, or his differences from other politicians.

The use of pointing cements the emotion being conveyed, anchoring it deeper in the mind, or connecting the speaker more firmly to his listeners.

Linguistics professor Christopher Hart, the author of the study, says “Self-pointing is functionally redundant so might not be expected to occur frequently but Trump uses them to contrast himself with other politicians. Self-points in other contexts do not normally make contact with the chest but Trump’s self-points do make contact with the chest the majority of the time. This might imply sincerity and allow Trump to connect with his audience on an emotional level.”

I highlight the note about ‘functional redundancy’ – he’s right, from a totally detached functional perspective, referring to yourself verbally while at the same time pointing at yourself seems redundant. Why not just use the words and skip the gesture?

The reality of course is that gestures are not functionally redundant; rather, they serve a purpose of highlighting, emphasizing, and directing the thoughts and emotions expressed to more firmly anchor them in the brain.

This works even if the target of the emotion is not named.

 

Using Pointing to Anchor Emotions

There’s an old good video from the BBC where interviewer Louis Theroux watches as Ross Jeffries, the founder of the NLP-based Speed Seduction and godfather of the modern seduction community, demonstrates NLP seduction. In the video, Ross uses liberal amounts of pointing to anchor emotions as he seduces a woman he’s just met.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xn_oqEOtLYU

How does that work? How is Ross able to generate emotions in a woman just by saying things then pointing at or touching her? Via the power of pacing and leading plus anchoring.

There are a variety of ways to use self- and other-points in seduction, not all of them direct.

A classic example is when you self-point while describing some characteristic you want a woman to anchor to you in her mind. For instance, if you are talking and say “some guys are just very exciting” while gesturing subtly toward yourself, the girl you’re talking to may not even consciously register your self-point – but subconsciously, her mind anchors the concept of “very exciting guy” to you.

Here are a few examples of frames and emotions it’s useful to anchor to yourself with a subtle self-point:

“The kind of guy you fall in love with”

“Someone who’s a bit mysterious and hard to figure out”

“Someone you just feel butterflies when you’re around”

“A man you feel an irresistible attraction to”

So for instance, if you’re talking to a girl, once she is hooked and is in a receptive mode with you, you might ask her, “Hey, let me ask you this: have you ever met a man you feel an irresistible attraction to?” while using a self-point. If you’re looking deep in her eyes as you say this, she won’t consciously register your self-point; she’ll be focused on your eyes and the emotion you’re discussing with her. Yet subconsciously, the emotion anchors to you, and she begins to feel you are a man she has some kind of irresistible attraction to.

The effect is subtle, but the effect is noticeable.

Obviously, if you anchor a bunch of frames and expectations to yourself that are incongruent with everything else you are doing/saying, and every other way you present yourself, the anchoring you do will not overcome all those other signals. A man who is very bland and vanilla who self-points while talking about “dangerous, exciting men” is still not going to make her find him particularly ‘dangerous’ or ‘exciting’.

READ MORE: Being Yourself: How Important is Congruence?

Do your words, actions, and presentation align — or do they weirdly conflict?

However, if you anchor frames congruent with the way you’re presenting yourself and behaving around her, the anchoring only serves to strengthen those frames.

That is to say: if you are already acting like a sexy bad boy around her, and you anchor the frame of “exceptional lover” to yourself, that frame is generally going to stick.

 

Anchoring Emotions to Her

We don’t just self-point to create anchors, however. We can also other point.

What happens if you talk about “a girl in search of a good adventure” and point at her, then talk about “a man whose life is filled with adventure” as you self-point? Well, you’ll anchor the emotion of ‘looking for an adventure’ to her, in her mind, even as you anchor the emotion of ‘man capable of providing adventure’ to yourself, in her mind.

NLP seducers use entire routines to set these various frames and anchors. I won’t go into that here – but I do want you to understand the power of the self- and other points.

Let’s say you’ve got a girl at a bar who’s being resistant with you. She isn’t leaving, but she’s acting cagey and difficult whenever you talk to her. You decide to frame her as being difficult because she is horny, and yourself as a man able to resolve that issue for her. Here’s how that looks:

YOU: That seems like it’d be a challenging major.

HER: [stares at you a moment] I guess.

YOU: [pause] You know, sometimes at bars you run into someone who’s all wound up with pent up sexual tension. [gesture toward her] It’s pretty common; I mean, it’s why some people go to bars in the first place. Because at bars, you will also meet other folks who know how to resolve that tension [self-point] and are very good at it. Convenient thing, bars! Anyway, how’d you end up at this school in the middle of nowhere?

Use your gestures and anchor emotions where you want them.

While it seems like this bit of conversation comes out of nowhere, it’s actually prompted by her giving-you-nothing behavior. You don’t outright call her sexually pent-up, nor do you outright say that you’re a guy who can fix that for her. But by gesturing to her as you deliver one part of this short speech, and gesturing to yourself as you deliver another part of it, you get the message clearly across: “You are sexually pent up, but fortunately, you’ve run into the right guy.”

Then you switch topic right back to something in line with what you were discussing before the mini speech.

Can this work? I use this approach often with girls giving me some kind of resistance, combining a cold read about why I think she’s resisting me plus a vague statement about the reasons plus solution, made specific through self- and other points. The result is pretty much always that the girl warms up a lot right after.

How much of the warming up is due to you accurately reading where her head is at with your cold read?

How much of it is due to the frames you set, then anchor to herself and you?

I can’t say for sure, but I can tell you it works.

 

Pointing Away Negativity

Here’s a final tip (which I covered in my article on anchoring earlier), but any time boring or negative topics come up, if it’s something you have to address and cannot get off of, use distracted eye contact and gesture away from yourself (and the girl, unless you want to frame her as boring or negative for some reason, such as to tease her or put pressure on her to stop being that way).

The reason for this is that it anchors the negative, boring topics outside yourself and the girl – effectively exorcising them from your courtship.

 

Conclusion

You probably point sometimes without even realizing it.

Hand gestures are a natural part of human communication.

Yet by being more deliberate in your use of gestures, you can better anchor the frames and emotions you wish to create in your conversations with girls.

Try it out and see!

Chase

Title: Mindsets of a Nightlife Seducer: Beginning the Night | Girls Chase
content:
Alek Rolstad walks you through the mindsets of a seducer as he prepares for a night out on the town – plus what goes through his mind early on in his night.

Hey guys. Welcome back.

Today’s post has a different focus. While it may seem like a report, it is not. I will present a hypothetical scenario to illustrate my thought process in the field. Instead of analyzing the interactions, I want to discuss the various mental states I experience that guide my decision-making during an outing. My goal is to create an introspective reflection that reveals what occurs when facing different situations and challenges.

I have historically tried to incorporate this aspect in my field reports. However, most reports focus on events, such as the conversations, techniques I use, reasons behind their effectiveness, the girl’s responses, and my reactions to those responses. As a result, there is little room to explore what goes on inside my head.

I initially wanted this to focus on a specific outing. However, upon reflection, I realized that the outing I chose was similar to many others I’ve experienced, and my thought process is the same. Using a hypothetical scenario based on actual events gives me more flexibility. This approach allows me to create more hoops and settings, and I can better describe how I react to them. I am not confining myself to the narrative of what actually happened.

Before I begin, note that I am making these scenarios more negative than usual. This lets you see my mindset and strategic decision-making skills in handling challenging situations. They may seem more difficult than your typical outing. So, do not let this demotivate you. Most outings will be more favorable. The key is that despite unfavorable situations, you can still use your skills to turn the tide.

 

It Starts at Home
Eat well before a long night out.

To perform at your best, it’s important to eat healthy. Consider including salads, vegetables, and unprocessed meats in our meals—just skip the onions and garlic. Healthy food boosts my mood and maintains a good state. Since the night may be long, be sure to eat well.

Have you showered and shaved? Great! Now, choose your clothes. If you are going to a fancy venue, opt for a blazer. If the venue is more street, a bomber jacket could work well. A leather jacket paired with a shirt is a good choice for more laid-back places.

Next, consider where you are going. Do you have a clear plan? Make sure you dress appropriately for the venue. If you don’t have a clear idea, dress in a way that offers flexibility. If your state is good, go bold and full flash. A more laid-back clothing style might be the better option. If your state is weaker.

A few cups of tea for caffeine, and I am out the door. The moment I exit, I take a deep breath and smell the night. I notice the powerful darkness, which is not threatening, but suggests a night of joy, socialization, and opportunities. I hear the laughter, enthusiasm, and the pre-parties in the neighborhood. I know that I am dressed to kill, and I walk as if I am going into battle. Here I come, night!

As I walk toward my selected venue, I sense the night’s mystery and imagine what this night will bring—perhaps something mind-blowing. I let myself feel intrigued to discover it.

This curiosity makes me feel engaged and motivated. You never know what the night will bring, and the best nights are those you never saw coming—those nights where you expected the least. And this is a huge motivator for me.

 

Entering the Venue
Your choice of venue matters.

Which venue should I go to? What do I feel like tonight? Do I want to go verbal? If so, I want a place to talk in calmer environments. Do I want to play it physically? I may choose a social proof game and be a social butterfly. This depends on my state and what venues are available.

Next, I consider other venues to move to if things do not work out. Say I experience a poor male-to-female ratio in my first venue. Or, if the place is dead or dies out sooner than expected, I’ll want backup venues. I have three other venues nearby that I like. Great. Homework and preparation help your success.

And if things work out, and I want to isolate a girl, I have quiet venues in mind where I am unlikely to be disturbed.

I think about nearby food places and transportation. Now, my plan is clear. It’s time to walk into the venue.

I never walk by the entrance and never walk by the bouncers before entering. I do not want them to judge me prematurely. If I have to make a detour, I do so.

Next, I get in the line. I ensure I have no idiots in front of me, as the bouncers may reject me due to a spillover from the rejection momentum the losers create. The same goes if the group in front of me are all men. I let people pass in front of me until I have some mixed groups or girls in front. The same applies to those behind me. If it’s a group of men, or they seem like idiots, I let them pass. I know that bouncers may reject me to make it easier for them to reject those behind me.

This doesn’t apply if I know the bouncer(s). I never try to skip the line unless the bouncers tell me I can. Even if I know them, it is still not classy.

Now, it is my turn to get in. I make sure I appear relaxed with a smile on my face. I greet the bouncer and let him do the talking. I respond and enter the venue.

Sometimes, bouncers ask some testy questions. I wrote a post dealing with this, so check it out.

The first 15 minutes inside the venue are crucial. I am new in this venue, and new blood always gets attention. I walk through the club to get as much positive attention as possible. Walk slowly, in a confident manner. Scout the venue and the crowd. Consider the logistics. What is the dynamic? Where can I open? How should I open? Where can I isolate? Then, decide on the best strategy to run.

Of course, if I get some positive eyes on me, I will open. But for now, I scout.

Then, it’s time to get a drink and consider how to engage the venue. I cannot scout for too long, or else I lose momentum and the crowd may generate a negative perception of me.

 

So It Begins: Openings
Start easy to build some momentum.

I consider easy sets to approach. Who seems the most open? Did anyone give me an approach invitation?

Where does it seem most easy to open? On the dance floor? Near the bar? In transit areas (my favorite).

Start simple. The goal is not to meet your dream girl (yet) but to get the machinery going. My state needs to be high.

Is the venue big or small? In larger venues, I can go in more ballsy and risk rejection, as the crowd will overshadow any rejections. I must be careful in smaller venues or those with much visibility, as people may see everything.

In venues with plenty of visibility, my approach is a way to build social proof. I may position myself so nearby girls can see it, or I may walk around with my new targets and then go for shots. The more I walk around with them, the more people see me.

I notice there are girls around I can spillover into by using my current lead to enter adjacent sets. I can introduce the new girls to my past leads.

I check the vibe. If it is high energy, I may need to use a high energy approach. If the vibe is chill, I use a rapport-based approach. If I hit the dance floor, I need to be sexual and mysterious. But it is too early for the dance floor. The venue is pumping and very high energy, so my approach will match.

Are there any approach invitations? I go in. If not, I try to trigger them. If there are still none, I go in anyway but do so safely.

I walk by a group and try to make eye contact. I get it and make a gesture to get their attention. They bite and I deliver my opener. They don’t reciprocate, so I move on. If one person seems friendly, I deliver a one-liner. If they bite, good; if not, I move on.

I get some leads. Girls bite. If they are in a group, I engage them all. I get the set going. I try to hook and spike. I lock. Now, I focus on each girl by commenting to each or asking some rapport questions. I get to know them.

So far, so good. Keep going. Deliver a gambit to the group. The plan is to spike the vibe. The ultimate goal is to create a favorable setting until I get a strong vibe with my target girl, I get a chance to isolate, or something accidentally occurs that gives good logistics.

However, none of this is happening. Argh. I move the entire set somewhere more favorable. Moving the group can create more rapport in a setting where I can run a more favorable verbal game with the hope that my target bites.

It’s still not working. Now, I am running out of things to say, and I sense that the vibe is slowly dying. It is time to get out. Leave them wanting more and re-engage later. The last thing I want is to let the vibe die. Leave on a high note. The vibe may be better upon re-opening. The situation or logistics may improve later. The girls may be more social and excited about seeing me, their states may be higher, and my target’s friends may be busy with other men. The current setting is not ideal, and I cannot improve it. The night is young, so I will look elsewhere.

I open a few more sets. Some go better than others. But none go through.

 

The Cursed State Drop
You can’t count on things to stay consistently perfect…

Damn, my state drops! After several unsuccessful set attempts, I do not feel like engaging anyone. I don’t have my X-factor any longer. Darn! Okay…I take a deep breath and tell myself to relax. I have been in this situation before. Let’s change locations in the venue. I decide to go outside to the smoking area.

When outside, I look for a good set. There’s a group of three. I go in with a rapport-based verbal approach and deliver a situational statement. I do this to smoothly transition into an intriguing topic about the venue and the people. Great; it bites! I try something juicy and deliver a clever line. Girl X gets testy. She appears to be the leader. I need to control the frame and win her over. If I do, I can run the rest of the group and focus on my main target.

It seems like a challenging set. But that’s fine. I have a lot to work with. They may crack eventually, and I know that sometimes, with an early challenge, the rest is easy. Now, my motivation has increased.

The set hooks. I try to for a juicy sexual gambit. It bites, but one girl is skeptical. I deal with it by giving a clever comeback. It doesn’t work. I agree to disagree and change the subject. I try to get the vibe back up. It works!

A snag: the girls want to go back inside. The lead is good, but I will not tag along unless they invite me. They do not invite me. Damn.

Okay. I take a break. A new group comes out, so I repeat the process. They hook, and all is good. The vibe is great. They also want to go back inside, but this group invites me.

On the way in, see if I can spot past leads and re-engage them while I am with my new leads. My plan is to introduce them to each other. It will not matter whether my new girls connect with my past girls. The point is to generate free social proof, which is always great. It helps me appear more attractive.

Another snag: some guys come over. I introduce myself to them. I remain polite but unaffected. But the situation improves as they hit on some of the girls, giving me space to hit on my target. But then, they try to dominate the entire set: crap. Worse yet, they start making snarky comments about me. I thank them for their clever remarks and ignore them, hoping that will do the trick.

But for some reason, it does not, and now the worst-case scenario is happening: the group starts to ignore me. I stay for a few minutes to see what happens. I try to get back in. It’s not working, so I exit.

I open or re-engage past leads. I may find a new group to use as a pivot to return to the previous set. This would offer me free social proof and make me seem of a higher value than any of these other guys. I will also not seem needy when re-engaging.

But no good leads are in sight and now the venue is dying off.

 

Changing Venues
A lucky encounter, infused with good energy, shepherded along with compliance.

I walk around one more time. Maybe the set that went south is now in a better setting. I may be able to give it a last shot. It does not work out.

The venue is dying, my leads are dying, and my state is dying. What a crappy night. But I have been here before. It’s not my first rodeo. Anything can happen on any given night. It only takes one good lead to be successful. I know that new venues provide new opportunities.

So, I walk to one of my backup venues and into a new setting with new people. With new opportunities, my state increases.

It’s time to make an entrance. Dance floor? Why not?

A cute girl bumps into me. It is late, so the vibe is more sexual, with the girls more amped up. It’s time to get a bit bolder and more sexual. The clock is ticking, so I need to take some risks. She appears compliant, which gives me the confidence to proceed.

 

To Be Continued

This night could have been rough. However, you can navigate difficult situations effectively with the right mindset and strategic choices.

The good news is that your experiences may not be as tough as I’ve described. Still, you may encounter various obstacles. With the right skills and experience, you will know how to handle hoops and challenges.

Remember that there is always a solution and a right decision to make.

In the next two weeks, I will discuss mid- and late-game phases. I will share my thought process through these stages during an outing.

Stay tuned,

Alek

Title: Mindsets of a Nightlife Seducer: In the Middle of the Night | Girls Chase
content:
How does a skilled seducer think about ‘the game’ as his night out progresses? Take a tour through the inner workings of master seducer Alek Rolstad on an example night on the town.

Hey guys. Welcome back.

I am working on a series that explores my inner thoughts, particularly my mindset while in the field and my strategic decision-making. Using examples from a hypothetical scenario, I can discuss both potential and real-life situations. I deliberately create non-ideal scenarios filled with unfortunate circumstances and challenges. This approach lets me provide more effective examples.

Your night out will likely be more enjoyable than this hypothetical outing. That’s why I didn’t include a real outing or typical field report. The focus here is more on my techniques and what occurred, and the circumstances would probably be more favorable in a real situation. However, these hypothetical scenarios are inspired by actual events.

Last week, I discussed the earlier portions of the night, including opening and finding a lead. In last week’s hypothetical scenario, I decided to change venues as my leads in my first venue had dried out. When entering the new venue, I meet a new girl right away. This post covers the hypothetical scenario of mid- to late-game and my strategic decisions. I will also cover the hoops I may face and how I navigate them.

 

The Seduction Process
Seduction is a game of many moving pieces.

New venue, new opportunities. New girl, a new adventure.

Let’s discuss opening and hooking in early game. I do not enjoy this phase as much as the later stages of seduction. I am better at seduction game when you hook your target and you set the frames, deal with tests, build rapport, create a connection, isolate, handle logistics, and make it all happen. What I enjoy is genuinely connecting with a girl and getting to know her, eventually getting intimate with her—no sex, but isolating in a one-on-one interaction and having a deep talk about a fascinating topic or even a stimulating conversation about sex. Nothing beats sex talk to build intrigue and anticipation. It excites me as much as it excites her.

But it does not have to be verbal. You can build intimacy non-verbally by having an intimate dance on a pumping dance floor. Chaos is all around, yet you two have tension and a bubble around you. You are both in your own world. You may dance more slowly than the beat and forget about everything else—even the attention-seeking people next to you. It is just you and her. That’s the fun part.

Don’t forget about the strategic game of dealing with tests; It’s similar to playing chess, which I enjoy. Perhaps it’s because I love chess and other strategy games. Sometimes, things do not go as planned, and wildcards occur. There may be male competition and jealousy plots, which may trigger me, but in a positive way. After taking a deep breath to calm my nerves, I shift into strategy mode.

I consider my options and ask myself questions. How do I solve this puzzle? What choices do I have? Do I talk to other girls to resolve the jealousy plot? Should I focus on talking to her friends to win over my target girl, making it easier to get her back home? Or should I ignore my girl when she is testing me? Should I move her to a different location within the venue to reset the vibe? Or would it be better to buy her a drink and take her to the bar, away from the crowd? Is the vibe good enough for isolation to return to better frames and rapport? Should I re-engage with sex talk while back in isolation? Or is this overkill? Have I set the sexual frame well? Should I leave her wanting more?

The girl seems testy. Have I talked enough about sex that she wants more? What type of sex talk did she seem to react best to? And which material can I best run? After more conversation, I realize she is a maximalist type; okay, good! I will bombard her with sex talk. After all, it went well when we were talking about sex.

 

Unfortunate Interruptions
When her friends want to leave, you must handle it.

Despite progress, she wants to leave to find her friends. Do I go with her? Logistically speaking, this seems ideal. However, she may be leaving because things are escalating fast for her, causing some resistance. I did begin to ramp things up due to the venue’s sexual vibe. Maybe I should have focused more on comfort and rapport. But it is too late now.

I do have some time left, so I decide not to follow. I would try to stick with her if I am short on time because I have nothing to lose. In this case, doing so may be risky, as it would appear clingy. But if I have little time, this risk may be worth it.

I approach a few girls. Some are good leads, some are bad. I try different locations. Now the clock is ticking.

I talk to a girl in the smoking area, and another girl arrives. Great! This often happens late at night. I call her over and introduce her to the other girl. Jealousy plots mean compliance, and social proof helps create comfort. When other girls feel at ease around me, it shows that I’m a guy girls can feel comfortable with.

The new girl leaves, and I return to my initial target. We resume where we left off.

 

Initial Touch
That first touch can have a major splash.

But I have not touched my girl yet! I could sit closer and occasionally touch her to get her used to it. If it works out, I can ramp it up. However, that is still not enough. I may move her to the dance floor. I’ve set the frames, and the rapport is there. She is comfortable with my presence, she likes me, and the frame is solid. I am a cool guy who is not needy and has something to offer. The frame is sexual, yet one of compassion, safety, and mutual understanding.

Leading her to the dance floor may help seal the deal. I have to hit when the iron is hot. That’s what Gunwitch taught me when I was just a kid. She is likely to say yes when the window is open, but my chances are limited once her mood fades and the window closes.

I take her to the dance floor in an isolated spot and start light, slowing things down. Bit by bit, I move in closer. I follow a ladder; that’s the correct way to do it. Shoulder, hips, belly, back of neck, butt, chin…but wait. Fractionating it may be better. Maybe do a few spins and repositions, like face-to-face at first, spinning her around, having her back facing my crotch, then turning her back around, then escalate further.

Maybe I should kiss her! But not yet. Where tension flows, passion grows. I move in closer, about to kiss, but before our lips meet, I dodge and spin her around. As I spin her, I make her head spin around. She wants more; I want more. Now, we both want more.

Rinse, repeat. This time, I go in for a short kiss. I push her away and pull her back, then touch her a bit more. It’s time for a make-out session, a short but passionate one. Quality over quantity. I cut it, so as not to drag it out.

 

Extraction Attempts
At some point, you must aim to leave the venue with her.

I say to her, “Let’s get out of here.”

But she says no. She says she has to be with her friends. Darn it. Abort. Okay, what’s the best course of action? Finding her friends. I take her back to her friends and focus on befriending them, especially the leader. Then, we do some shots for good measure. After all, moving her around to different locations may generate more comfort and compliance. I remind myself of this often neglected yet key factor.

The set is going well, but I need to isolate. If I cannot isolate, I may move the entire group to a more favorable location. I take them outside to run a verbal game, as this gives me more control. I continue friendly talk to build more rapport. My girl should see her friends enjoying my presence.

Her friends want to go back inside. But my girl stays. I resume our earlier conversation to trigger anchors and get her back in a good mood. It works. Great. But now, George, her high school friend shows up. What to do? I get up and tell them I’m heading to the bathroom. Think, think, think!

I re-engage past targets. I see a girl I spoke to earlier. I re-engage her and invite her to meet some friends. I bring these girls to my initial target and introduce them. I counter any social proof and jealousy plots. George and the other girl leave, and I am back with my initial target. I resume our conversation. The vibe is up again, and I suggest we head to my place. After all, it would be best to continue this conversation over wine. I hope she likes wine. But she does not. Well, I have beer and vodka, and I do not live far away and will help her get home afterward. She says yes but needs to grab her jacket. It’s a tense moment. She may get distracted on the way inside, and horny men swarm around her. I grab her hand, and she follows my lead. We need to get this out of the way as soon as possible. She gets her jacket. But she has to say goodbye to her friends. Darn. Okay, we find her friends.

Finally, we find them! I tell the leader girl that I am taking her friend home. She seems skeptical. I give her my number and address. She calms down.

We are out of the club. We need to find a cab. I need to get her in there ASAP because there are too many horny guys roaming about. I do not fear them, but they can distract the mission, or worse, could be last-minute test pawns for a juicy jealousy plot I do not see coming.

There are no cabs. But I did my homework. I know that further up the street, there are many cabs. We walk there. I open the door. She jumps in.

Mission accomplished.

 

What If I Do Not Pull?
If you fail to pull, you must assess your options.

But what if things were not successful with that girl? It happens. It won’t be the first or last time. So, what do you do next? First, calm your nerves. Leave your frustration for tomorrow. Don’t give in to it now.

Are there any past leads to re-engage? Good. Let’s go. If I do not see any, I check if there are any new girls to approach.

Pick the easier ones. I look for whoever gives off a good vibe or an approach invitation. If I do not see any, I look for whoever is not in a logistically unfavorable setting—no girls surrounded by men or in a large group.

I open and try to escalate the vibe quickly. It is do or die. It’s time to shotgun.

But it’s not working out? Sad. But it happens.

Now, the venue is closing.

People are heading out. It is over. Or is it? Well, in wardrobe lines and on the way out of the club, there are many opportunities to open. Many girls may want last-minute company, and some are seeking after-parties. This provides an opening.

But it is still not working out. Remember, there is the outside of the club after closing time. I am not giving up. Why should I? I have had many great pulls before this way.

Keep moving forward. I see a cool-looking group. I position myself favorably next to them and open situationally. It either bites or it doesn’t. If it does, stick to it.

But still nothing. I check if there are any after-hour places I can head to If not, are there friends who may have an afterparty? I call around.

But I am still not getting anywhere. It’s time for food and to go home. Better luck next time. I deserve better but know that results are not based on merit.

 

To Be Continued

I ended up with the worst-case scenario. Again, if you do things right throughout the evening, the odds of getting to that point are low, especially if you are experienced and have decent momentum. But, for the sake of the example, we went through a bad night. You should learn how to handle all types of curve balls.

Next week, we will discuss my stream of thought when bringing a girl back to my place. We will continue the story from when I pull a girl. I will discuss my strategic choices and how I keep my head cool if I deal with last-minute resistance.

Stay tuned.

Best,

Alek

Title: How to Motivate Yourself to Pick Up Girls | Girls Chase
content:
You want women in your life but you can’t get off the couch. Are you lazy? Or are you just not doing what’s needed to MOTIVATE yourself to pick up girls?

We get guys periodically asking for help solving motivation issues around approaching and picking up women. Not the least of these being Sub-Zero, our long-time commenter who has long struggled with drive issues. Here’s a recent comment by him on the subject:

Actually getting some drive back, but still don’t have the drive to deal with everything that comes with the ups and downs of dating. I’m horny all the time and when I’m sleeping with women I’m always pleasing them, so I know that’s not the issue. I just don’t have the drive to keep going if things aren’t working out and quit. It makes me wonder how other guys can have no kind of success and can keep doing it. How do I get the drive to keep practicing and getting better instead of quitting?

All right then. Let’s talk about motivation.

I’ll see if I can come at it from a different angle than our many other articles on the subject.

First off, a couple of points:

This article is not a “you should be doing this” moral lecture. If you aren’t driven to approach or pick up girls, and you don’t want to be, that is fine. This guide is a tool, not  an order.

This article is also not a mandatory thing you have to follow even if you want to pick up. If you want to pick up girls, but just occasionally, and are happy with how it’s going, stick with it.

This article is for men who want MORE motivation to go out and approach more women but are struggling to find that motivation.

In other words, this is the article for men motivated to find the motivation to go out and pick up girls. Copy that?

 

The Spirit Is Willing but the Flesh Is Weak

What does it mean to wish you had the motivation to do something?

It’s a bit of a conundrum when you think about it:

Here is a man motivated to want to do something,

However, he is not sufficiently motivated to actually do it!

In fact, we encounter this ‘motivated to want to do what we aren’t motivated to actually do’ phenomenon in all kinds of things:

Wishing we had the motivation to kick a bad habit.

Wishing we had the motivation to set a new good habit.

Wishing we had the motivation to go out more and socialize.

Wishing we had the motivation to leave our current job.

Wishing we had the motivation to start our own business.

Wishing we had the motivation to exit a bad relationship.

Now, people work in different ways, and motivate themselves differently.

As the prison warden in 2002’s Count of Monte Cristo says (while noting the “God will grant me justice” inscription carved into the prison cell wall):

People are always looking to motivate themselves.

It’s true. We all wish we could somehow get ourselves to do more than we actually do.

The truth is, we are men, not machines. We cannot program ourselves to perform a desired function, then go out and mechanically execute it to perfection without resistance or fatigue.

We get tired. We get lazy. We lose focus. We lose interest.

We lose our motivation.

If we want ourselves to actually do what we want ourselves to do, then, we need to find a way around the inherent tendency of human beings (all living things, really) to avoid squandering energy on things that lack a guaranteed immediate payoff. We must instead lay a pathway for ourselves that gets us doing what we want to do.

 

Skill Builder Mentality
It’s time to level up like you’re a video game character.

I had a few false starts when it came to picking up girls.

There was when I was 17 years old, working in a department store, and I resolved to talk to at least one new girl a week – either another attractive coworker, a customer, or a girl I’d meet somewhere else in the mall. I managed to get a few approaches under my belt (even one upon the stunning girl who worked in the lingerie department!), but then I called it quits.

Then there was when I was 18 years old, down at the shore, with a whole plan about how I’d move there, get a job working at a restaurant, get an apartment, then hit the under-21 clubs every night dancing with girls until I figured out how to pick girls up. I went out a single night, got a few girls to dance with me, had a bunch more girls spurn me for dances, ended up sandwiched among a bunch of dancing, sweaty men, felt completely and utterly defeated, and threw in the towel on even trying to get girls for years.

It wasn’t until I was about to turn 22 that I finally learned to stick with it. I set a new approach goal – not every day; not even every week; just “approach three new girls” – and ended up hitting it… after a couple of months. Once I hit it, I set some new goals: next, instead of just approach, I’d ask girls for their phone numbers. Some girls told me no, but rather than a rejection beating me down like rejections had when I was 18, the very fact that I’d gone for a goal (even if I failed to reach it) encouraged me.

Then one day I got a number that was good. I went on a date. I went on more. I started going out more and talking to more women, then more. I learned how to pick girls up for one-night stands from nightclubs. I got a rotation going of girls I was seeing. I had friends with benefits. I took girlfriends.

As I progressed, I continued to set more goals: could I pick up girls from social circle? Could I pick up girls from day game? Could I pick up from the street, train, supermarket, library, park, you name it? Could I get hotter girls? Could I get girls with really big boobs? Could I get stunners with consistency? (answer to all of those: yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, and yes)

Why was I able to stick with it at 22 when I’d failed to do so when I’d tried it at 17 and 18?

A big part of what was missing was the correct skill progression to keep me motivated.

As a 17-year-old, I figured I’d talk to girls until I was able to get a date. But when I approached girls, I discovered just how far I was from being able to get dates. Like that stunner in the lingerie department – we had a very nice, platonic conversation that I knew had a 0% chance of ever leading to a date. Later I saw her going around with some guy on her lunch break. A date? A boyfriend? I figured I’d keep an eye on her and chat her up again a few months later – maybe she’d be single. This was the WRONG mentality. I was going for dates – I wasn’t going for skills.

As an 18-year-old, I’d realized I needed to skill-build, but I had an overly simplistic idea about what that’d be like. Sure, at first I figured I’d need to commit to months of going out and probably doing awful at the beginning, but I’d had limited real experience with girls rejecting me, and that first night out piling up a bunch of rejections hit like a ton of bricks. I was unprepared for it; it crushed my pride, and the whole plan of going out and doing that again night after night folded.

At last, as a 22-year-old, I came at it the right way:

I’d set small, achievable goals, aimed at inching my way toward greater success with women, until I’d arrived at a place where I could reliably get girls.

READ MORE: Goal Setting

Set goals — then hit them.

 

Small Goals Work Because They’re Rewarding
Basic fetch quests are a staple of skill progression in many role-playing games.

If you’ve ever played a really absorbing video game, and paid attention to how the game absorbed you, you will have noticed it went something like this:

At the start of the game, you had a very simple task to complete. You completed it and the game rewarded you.

Then you received another task to complete, this one slightly more complicated. Again, you completed it, and again the game rewarded you.

Next, you received another task, once again a bit more challenging than the last, but well within the ability of your growing skill set. Once again, you completed it, and the game rewarded you.

Most of your favorite games likely feature this smooth gradual escalation in challenges and rewards, which teach you over time how to play the game. You get into it, get hooked, have a hard time not playing, and get better and better at the game as you play.

A good set of goals in pickup is just like this. It consists of a series of achievable goals that escalate in challenge as you go, but never beyond the limit of what is doable for you.

One of the reasons students are ecstatic with me when I coach them to pick up girls in-field is because I construct game-like series of escalating goals or quests for them as we go through a session. Even a guy who has never approached a girl before can end up leaving with phone numbers or a girl on his arm when we do this because the right series of rapidly achievable ‘seduction quest’ milestones for a student allow him to progress rapidly in a one-on-one session.

Just like in a video game, you don’t tell the student all the upcoming quests ahead of time (that’d be overwhelming and get him in his head); you just tell him the current one. Then after he completes it, you assign him his next. Then his next. Before he knows it he’s doing stuff he's never done with girls before, beyond what he thought he was capable of doing, and he is hooked.

You can do this exact same thing to yourself, without a coach standing over your shoulder, IF you have the sense to do it. All you need to do is sit down for a few minutes and ask yourself, “What is the next small step I need to learn how to take with girls?” and that becomes your target.

You must do this regularly, or else you get trapped too long repeating the same ‘quest’ again and again. After you collect enough wolf hides in the video game, you don’t want to go back and keep collecting more wolf hides, because the XP gain is no longer very much. You need to move to a more challenging quest. So too with girls.

You learned how to approach, open, and banter? Great! But don’t limit yourself to just continuing to do that over and over then eject. You need to learn how to move girls next. You need to learn how to get some initial bonding going. You need to learn how to create high points so you can ask girls out.

 

Main Story Quest Goal vs. Tasks & Side Quests

A lot of guys get confused, then deflated, with seduction because they only focus on the Main Story Quest Goal of seduction. Depending on the guy, that typically comes down to some variation of ‘Get the Girl’ (or ‘Get Many Girls’, as the case may be!).

But if that is the only thing a guy focuses his energy on, it’s well nigh unachievable. It’d be like starting a big game, receiving the quest of “Save the Entire World”, except you are a super weak Level 1 character with no skills or abilities who dies fast, you have no idea what to do, and because there are no smaller quests or tasks to guide you, you just can’t get anywhere. People get very frustrated with games like this and quit them quick because they feel too unrewarding.

So too with seduction where guys only focus on the Main Story Quest Goal of ‘Get the Girl / Many Girls’. A guy will go out, chat up a few chicks, NOT get the girl, let alone MANY girls, feel like he’s failed, feel totally lost and unguided, feel completely unrewarded for his efforts, and soon give up.

Humans only stick with things that reward them. Just like an absorbing computer game, you have to set up a series of achievable seduction tasks to make your learning process rewarding to you.

You can have that Main Story Quest Goal of ‘Get the Girl’ in the back of your mind; that is fine.

But just like in a game, your immediate focus will not be that Main Story Quest Goal.

Instead, it will be the far more immediately achievable minor task or side quest that lies right in front of you – those achievable, bite-sized goals you lay out for yourself.

 

No More AFC Material

There’s another side to motivating yourself to pick up girls, too, and that is believing that you can actually do it. The rewarding progress you feel hitting goal after goal will help. But only if it isn’t being cancelled out by the media you consume.

All of us are deeply influenced by media we consume. The only time we aren’t is when our experience is so deep and broad that we know the things the media says are balderdash. The rest of the time, whatever we hear through our ears and see through our eyes gets added into our mental models of the world.

READ MORE: Mind Control: How Media Influence Your Thoughts and Feelings

Don’t let the media tell you what to believe.

The vast majority of men who create media are Average Frustrated Chumps. This goes doubly so for the men who churn out red pill, black pill, and incel media.

Yes, in the beginning, there were some skilled pick up artists and seducers involved in the red pill movement. These men were quickly pushed aside as the movement became a mass movement and bitter men flooded in en masse. Remember when “don’t talk about fight club” was the mantra of the pickup artist community, and one of the best known PUAs called himself Tyler Durden? Now the ‘fight club’ meme is tied to the cheesy mainstream-ish platitudes of the red pill and is all played out. Sad days!

Sub-Zero, our commenter we started this article with, has made repeated reference in his comments on Girls Chase articles about the messages he gets from AFC red pill influencers, which he says confuse him. Girls Chase says this, but AFCs say that. Who is correct?

Here’s the deal: if a guy isn’t getting what he wants in life, he’s average, and he’s frustrated, and he’s a chump. If a guy is going onto media and complaining up, down, left, right, and center about women, he is not getting what he wants with women, and he is an Average Frustrated Chump. If you are listening to all this Average Frustrated Chump media, and you are letting this stuff into your brain, and you are wondering if it might be correct, you are letting it turn you into an Average Frustrated Chump.

I can watch AFC media and have it wash right over me. I can listen to these guys spout out “their truths” about “modern women” and I know it’s bunk because I have enough experience with modern women to know these guys have a.) picked BADLY and b.) run their relationships BADLY. Furthermore, I know that if these guys were getting laid a lot, and not going for the broken chicks they are going for, and running their relationships with a modicum of skill, they would not be dealing with the problems they complain about constantly with women, because nobody who is doing things correctly has to deal with these things – at least not to the extent where it’s screwing the guy’s life up utterly like these guys’ lives are screwed up.

Almost every single man producing red pill or black pill media today is an Average Frustrated Chump. Men who consume this stuff fill their heads with mental models downloaded from Average Frustrated Chumps. If you want to be an AFC, the easiest way in the world is to listen to AFC music, watch AFC movies, suck up AFC podcasts, then go out into the world and think, feel, and act like all the AFC stuff you have downloaded into your skull.

I have even seen with skilled pickup artists who got away from the game for a bit, then started consuming heaps of AFC material, that they reverted to AFC mentalities and started complaining about all these AFC complaints. Whenever this has happened and I have asked the guy, “Hey man, I respect you a lot, and you had a lot of experience in the past – but are you in the field right now or is this coming from media you consume?” the answer is always the same: the guy is not in the field right now and is just consuming media.

THE MEDIA LIES TO YOU. It is filled with people with extremely limited experience, who are living in their heads, concocting schemes and hypothesis based on their imaginations, remixing ideas they picked up from other men living in their own heads, creating this entire fabricated reality of nonsense and unreality.

READ MORE: Are You Free or Do the Glowing Screens Direct You?

You are not truly free if the screens you look at program you.

The less you are out in the real world interacting with flesh and blood women and actually having deep and involved relationships with them – having deep flirtations, deep connections, going on dates, getting intimate with them, having relationships with them, and doing this often, not occasionally – the more susceptible you will be to having your mind filled with propaganda broadcast out of AFCs online.

If you consume AFC material, unless you are KNEE DEEP IN THE FIELD, you will become more and more like an AFC.

Reading Girls Chase while also consuming a bunch of AFC material is not enough to inoculate yourself against this stuff. In theory, if you are reading Girls Chase, plus heavily in the field, you should be able to consume a bunch of AFC material and not have it affect you. However, in practice, as soon as you are in the field a lot, having lots of actual experience with women, and progressing through game (hopefully helped along by stuff you are learning from the Girls Chase website, and/or my book, and/or One Date/TDA), you will not have an appetite for AFC rants and lamentations anymore.

Instead, you will just turn them on, find their perspectives extremely average, find the frustration in them grating, and view the guys spouting these perspectives as chumps – then you will turn that media off.

You should not be consuming this stuff AT ALL when you are trying to motivate yourself. It is anti-motivational. It is motivation-destroying.

Listening to some guy rant about how there are no good women left, or women are all raging sluts, or women only want men with 10/10 male model looks, or whatever AFC tripe a guy is consuming, is only going to deflate you.

You listen to that blather, and what’s the point of even trying with girls?

Why would you bother if “women only want men who are young, rich, good-looking, tall, and famous?” That excludes 99.999% of the male population – including you, me, every guy I know who is actually good with girls, and everybody else. There are like 3 guys who are getting all the girls according to this AFC claptrap. So what’s the point? If you’re not one of those 3 guys, sorry, all the girls on Planet Earth don’t want you. Does that sound reasonable?

You’ve gotta tune that stuff out.

If it’s so important for you to listen to, you are not ready to motivate yourself to pick up girls.

YOU MUST CHOOSE:

Fill your mind with anti-motivational victim mentality crap, or turn that AFC bullshit off and go get good with girls.

Your choice, hombre.

 

Axing Out AFC Friends/Associates
They may be great guys, but they are not going to help your dating life.

Finally, this is not a problem I’ve had to deal with myself (largely because I didn’t have friends, really, when I started on this journey; and since then I’ve only kept friends around who were cool and good with girls), but I have had multiple guys tell me about this:

You need to cut AFC friends/people out of your life.

At the very least, you need to NOT TALK TO THEM ABOUT GIRLS AT ALL.

These people are like crabs in a bucket. If you start making moves to succeed with girls they will pull you down. Who knows why? Some part of them just doesn’t want to see someone else winning if they can’t win themselves, I guess.

Personally, I can’t stand to have this type of person around me in anything I’m trying to do. I don’t care if it’s business, writing, girls, whatever. If I have some dude around me who is telling me, “Dude, that won’t work. That could never work. Don’t you know [some AFC rule]?” I am just going to cut that guy out.

(that is not to say I do not want constructive criticism. If I am doing something truly foolish I definitely want to know about that. But I don’t want stupid AFC criticisms from some guy who’s never done or succeeded at the thing I am doing and has no meat to his opinions about why it won’t work – or alternative suggestions about things he knows for a fact absolutely do work. Handwringing like that is just poison)

You are responsible for policing your own influences. You’re going to allow a bunch of AFCs around you filling your head with AFC beliefs? Then you will be an AFC.

You know the old saying:

You are the combination of your five closest friends.

This is absolutely, shockingly, almost unnervingly true. I have never yet met an exception to it.

If I was talking to Sub-Zero, our commenter, right this moment, the first thing I would ask him is, “How many of your five closest friends would you consider Average Frustrated Chumps?” I bet he’ll say most of them are AFCs. He might even say all of them.

Does this mean you can’t have AFC friends? No.

But it’s going to be hard to motivate yourself to pick up girls if all your friends are AFC.

If picking up girls is truly important to you, I suggest you reduce the amount of time you spend with people like this.

In time, you will find new (cooler/more ambitious/more effective) friends.

For now, you may want to make an account on our forum, Skilled Seducer, and start posting on there. Active seducers are a rare breed nowadays, in an age of AFC swipe app addictions and red pill rage & frustration, and many of the guys on Skilled Seducer have become real life friends, after sharing their exploits and bonding over the game online.

There’s little that will motivate you to excel with girls than hanging around other guys who excel with girls.

Even OG pickup artists who’ve retired from the game will often come out of retirement and make some approaches when they meet up with younger, active, ambitious seducers from the community. Being around guys who are doing the thing you want to do, or like to do, or used to do, is often all it takes to wake up that dormant side and start your engine up again.

Cut out AFC friends (or at the very least stop talking to them about dating and girls) and start surrounding yourself with folks who take the game seriously.

 

Conclusion

This article could’ve been a lot shorter, in some ways.

I could’ve just told you “set achievable goals that progress as you achieve them, and cut out AFC media influences and friends.” But it’s been my experience that when you just state things simply, without a deep explanation why, many people gloss over it.

But that is the gist – the meat and potatoes of our approach to motivating yourself to go out and pick up girls:

Set small, achievable goals (‘quests’) that are within your reach right now with girls.

Once you hit your goals, set NEW goals. Do this REGULARLY. At least once per week.

Cut out Average Frustrated Chump music, movies, shows, podcasts, accounts, and channels. This includes the vast majority of ‘red pill’ stuff (which these days is pretty much all AFC).

Cut out Average Frustrated Chump friends and acquaintances – or if you don’t want to cut them out or can’t, at least quit talking to them about women and dating, and don’t let them talk to you about it.

Find some cool friends active in pickup you can hang around to help motivate yourself better to stick with it. You can also join our forum (especially useful if you don’t have access to motivated seducers around you right this moment).

Do those things – REALLY do them; don’t just ‘think about doing them’ – and you will discover the motivation to pick up girls starts to flower in your breast; then begins to blossom in full.

Once you’re out there making progress, it starts to legitimately become fun.

The only thing that will stop your newfound motivation? If you cease to do these things – and give up achievable quests or hanging around seducer friends, to instead immerse yourself in inaction, and AFC points of view.

Yours,
Chase

Title: Why Feigning Disinterest (Usually) Does Not Work | Girls Chase
content:
If a girl’s not investing as much, you may be tempted to feign disinterest. But all too often this technique is see-through. Here’s what to do instead.

It’s a pretty common strategy for guys who are learning to do better with girls to try to feign disinterest in them.

After all, you figure out pretty quick that there’s a whole power balance that occurs during the courtship dance. Show too much interest, your attainability goes too high, she feels like she’s “got you already”, then her interest in you drops to zero.

So it’d make sense to try to reduce how much interest you’re showing by feigning actual disinterest – you’d think.

But as you’re about to see, feigning disinterest much of the time is not going to work out the way you hope it will.

Instead, all too often, it backfires.

 

Feigned Disinterest: An Obvious Ploy

You won’t realize it when you’re starting out, but feigned disinterest is obvious.

It is very obvious to other people when the disinterest you show is feigned (i.e., fake).

Let’s put the shoe on the other foot to demonstrate how.

Imagine you’re at a party talking to a group of people. In the group is a girl you can tell likes you. However, everyone in the group knows you and is trying to talk to you. The girl is obviously a bit annoyed at being interrupted several times when she tries to chat you up.

Finally you get a moment to talk to her, but she rolls her eyes a bit and turns away from you as if she’s uninterested in talking to you. She strikes up a conversation with the girl next to her, all too obviously (to you) doing it to come across “totally disinterested” in communicating with you.

Even though she is supposedly disinterested in you, you can tell she’s monitoring you through her peripheral vision – after all, it’s a technique. She needs to make sure it’s working. If it backfires and you think she’s really not interested, then start completely ignoring her or leave, she’ll have to scramble to get you back.

…

Right away we can see how obvious her feigned disinterest is.

Aside from being obvious though, it also tells us a few other things about her:

She doesn’t feel confident expressing her REAL levels of interest. Instead she’s playing this ‘game’.

She likes you enough that she’s engaged in this elaborate scheme to try to influence how you think about her. She is definitely not following the Law of Least Effort.

She may well be difficult to make something happen with. Although she clearly likes you a lot, due to her penchant for game playing it’s not clear you’d actually be able to make something happen with her – or whether you’d just run into a ‘wall of games’.

Well guess what?

When you feign disinterest in women, it’s every bit as obvious to them, and they read these same exact notions from when you do it as you do when a girl does.

Take it from me; I was a paragon of feigned disinterest at the beginning of my seduction career – and it backfired on me repeatedly until I learned to ditch this stupidly obvious ‘technique’.

But this doesn’t even cover all the reasons why it’s so bad.

 

No Challenge for Some; Unattainable for Others

Feigning disinterest screws with your attainability in ways that are unpredictable, due to how much it depends on the girl you use it with. Think about it like this:

To a socially confident and savvy girl, feigned disinterest is obvious. She sees right through it, knows you are working harder to get her than she is to get you, and you become too attainable (i.e., ‘no challenge’). Attraction lost.

On the other hand, to a socially unconfident or unsavvy girl, feigned disinterest looks like you putting a wall up to her. She might realize it’s a game you’re playing but not feel equal to your test; or she might actually think you’re really not interested in her. Either way, your attainability plummets, and she now believes you are out of her reach. Once again, attraction lost.

In other words, feigning disinterest is a kind of attainability wildcard.

It’s like playing Russian roulette with your attainability. Except that in this case, rather than one bullet and five empty chambers, it’s more akin to five bullets and one empty chamber. That’s about how often the tactic fails versus works to your advantage.

But if you can’t feign disinterest, what SHOULD you do?

 

Balancing the Interest Differential
You can’t just leave the interest levels lopsided. You have to balance things out — WITHOUT being too transparent about it.

People resort to feigning disinterest when an imbalance opens up in how much interest they’re showing vs. how much their potential paramour is showing.

Case in point: our example from the start of the article. The girl keeps trying to talk to you, but others keep interrupting her and pulling your interest away. If you were equally interested as she was, you’d sideline those others or tell them to wait and stay in the conversation with her. You allowing others to interrupt her and break the circle despite her repeated attempts to initiate tells anyone paying attention that she wants this more than you.

Anytime you find yourself thinking about feigning disinterest, it’ll be in a similar unequal interest situation:

You’ve approached a girl, but her girlfriends are sucking up her attention.

You’re in a group, trying to talk to a girl, but others keep monopolizing her.

You’re on a date, but your date keeps checking notifications on her phone.

In any of these situations, your first instinct will be something like, “Well, I can’t leave, because then I’ll miss my shot with this girl, but I also don’t want to look like I’m just waiting idly by either, because then I look way more invested than she is.”

So you end up feigning disinterest: talking to someone else then acting a bit disinterested when she tries to reengage; checking your own phone and acting like there’s something important there; etc. But of course this is transparent. She can tell what you’re doing. She’s not dumb.

The big clue is that you don’t go anywhere. If you were really disinterested, you’d leave. SHE didn’t leave because other things were genuinely taking her time (people yanking her into conversations or her phone sucking up her attention). There was nothing commanding your time like that… but you hung around anyway. Why? Because you like her. And she knows it.

Thus, we have two (2) ways to deal with this situation where a girl appears to be showing less interest or investment than you are in her.

One is to actually leave (or make like you’re about to leave) the situation.

The other is to simply chill out, wait, then feign zero disinterest when she’s ready to reengage.

 

Option #1: The Takeaway

Our  first option is to use a takeaway.

Note: I do not recommend this option for dates. It’s overkill here. Use Option #2 for that.

That is, you are actually going to depart from her presence.

This is simple enough to do in social venues (bars, parties, events). It also works fine in social circle – classes, the office, other gatherings. If she’s too slammed with people vying for her attention right now, you simply leave and go talk to other people.

Before I use a takeaway, I often like to turn my body language out away from the girl, expand my awareness radius, and look around a bit – planning out my next move. What I have found happens much of the time is that girls who were playing games or else were just being too ADD and letting themselves get distracted will recognize this and change focus to you to hook you back in. In essence, you’re announcing (nonverbally) that you’re preparing to leave before you do. That way, if she wants to keep you there, she has a few seconds (generally I will give her 5-10 seconds as I ‘ponder’ leaving before I do) in which to act. If her interest is high enough, she usually will (unless, e.g., you’re at a loud nightclub and she is drunk, etc. – girls’ awareness goes down a lot in these cases).

Assuming she does not stop you, and you do leave, you don’t keep an eye on her. You don’t check in on her. You just go. If she likes you, she’ll be monitoring you to see if you’re checking up on her – she wants to gauge if this is an act (i.e., feigned disinterest) or if she really just hasn’t interested you enough yet. If you don’t bother visually keeping tabs on her, she’s a lot more likely to imagine it must be that your interest levels simply are not super high.

Later on, you may circulate back to her and reopen her when she isn’t as occupied. How long to wait depends on the venue and context. In a classroom or at a small party you may be fine reopening her five minutes later. In a nightclub you may not want to run back into her for 30-40 minutes.

The fact that you were fine leaving (which runs the risk of actually losing her – since she may not be there when you return) stabilizes the interest differential and tells her your interest levels are probably pretty close to hers.

After all, she was willing to ‘leave’ you by letting other things distract her from you. You  were willing to leave by actually leaving.

Once again: I recommend against using takeaways on your dates. Whether it’s your first date or she’s your girlfriend of a few months, ditching her because she keeps checking her phone or people are monopolizing her around you just looks childish. Walking off is what you do with someone you aren’t closely tied with (yet!).

 

Option #2: Just Wait

Option #2 if the girl you want to talk to is engaged in something / with someone else is to just wait. Don’t feign disinterest. Don’t copy her. Just relax.

If there are other people around you can get into casual conversations with, good. I do NOT suggest pulling out your phone… it looks lame. Even if she’s on her phone herself (you’re just copycatting her at that point). But chatting with other people is okay.

You should not be glancing at her or visually checking up on her while you do this much. The occasional glance is okay. But you can stare off into space, examine your nails, clean your shoes/boots, chat up the person next to you – all these work.

When she comes back to the conversation with you, don’t feign disinterest. If you have someone else you’re talking to, don’t unceremoniously ditch that person (looks reactive on your part), but do quickly wind down the conversation to return to the girl you’re with.

Your girl KNOWS you stuck around because you’re with her. There’s no sense hiding that. So don’t hide it. But be chill about waiting.

If she makes you wait too long (depends on the scenario; “too long” can be anything from two to five minutes), you will either need to interject to get the conversation going again, or you may need to use more drastic measures. See our other articles on handling interruptions/disruptions.

Most of the time, however, assuming you’ve hooked the girl and she’s into you, she will come back to you.

 

Conclusion

I don’t recommend feigning disinterest.

Most of the time, it’s a transparent tactic that makes you look weaker for doing it.

Some of the time, it backfires spectacularly, because the girl thinks you’re playing games or just not interested.

Instead, learn to use takeaways or learn to just chill out and wait. For 95% of cases, these two measures are all you’ll need.

(are there times feigning disinterest can work? Yes. It is sometimes a useful technique. But most of the time it’s used by most guys you will run into this backfires problem. Use one of the better options instead!)

Cheers,
Chase Amante

Title: Eliciting Values & Details from Women in Conversation | Girls Chase
content:
Connect deeply with women by diving into their values, motivations, and experiences – then, after you’ve elicited these, stimulate on their responses.

This post by Glow originally appeared on our forum here.

A subtle but powerful key to managing conversations with women.

Game Generation One tended to rest a lot on spitting game; the art of leading and plowing with multiple stimulating techs. This is definitely useful. Using statements instead of techniques followed. Muti-threading conversations and other techniques came next. These are the more famous ones. Other schools of seduction used other means for conversation management and there are many routes for it.

One such more subtle form of driving, managing and leading convos is elicitation:

to evoke or draw out (a reaction, answer, or fact) from someone.

to draw forth (something that is latent or potential) into existence.

In a seducer’s view, it becomes the art of drawing out her world, to engage her in talking about her. To draw her out. Doing so is a subtle but powerful way to grab attention by activating her, by showing interest for her. And you are leading what she brings out.

At the same time she feels interest for her world, and if done well, it will take her to interesting things she has not connected with in a while. Perhaps never really thought about. Another dimension is that she becomes reactive to you. And the experience is very nice for her. So many good things.

 

Step 1: Eliciting Values & Details Through Questions

You draw out things in the simplest form by asking questions and by being active in doing so:

Asking what she does and eliciting values (a seemingly mundane question that you make her deepen into why she does it, why she chose it).

Nudging further into topics she brings up through active asking into these in stimulating ways.

Eliciting how the guys are treating her (brings up her wants, views and experiences, you can then frame and take authority on).

Asking into themes and her view of them.

Eliciting good things paced to her now and her experience – e.g. dancing inside a club.

Specifically framed questions that supply subtle cues and hints that are loaded.

Actively ask further in by interrupting; "Wait – Tell me more about xxx" (credit: Zan Perion)

This is done well by being grounded and curious, while confidently leading it. Theres a subtle power in this, being the director of focus, getting people to respond to you.

 

Step 2: Stimulate on Her Responses

Now use what she provided to stimulate her:

Stimulate the responses through emotional stimulation – picturesque descriptions, emotional description, etc.

You can add techs e.g. mini cold reads, adding drama, breaking rapport, listing, contrasting, push pulls, statements, pacing and leading.

You can nudge the conversation in new directions based on her topics and leads – fun and interesting topics, emotional and imaginative topics, romantic and sensual topics.

Vibe shifts, slight attention take-aways or alike.

You can steer topics, e.g., through weasel phrases (credit: Ross Jeffries) into SOTS or sex talk then back to other things.

Give i – give her things from your world: experiences, themes. She can then mirror this, which is basically you baiting her to talk on specific subjects if you give i smartly.

You can shape your own frame and style (how you do things) along her visions for life, what she sees herself as, depictions and what she wants, images of what she craves.

You can understand how to connect with her, make her feel like she belongs, rapport-ish side of things.

The above are MANY options for getting her stimulated and will provide variation in your stimuli. But just pick 1 or 2 to begin with. Slowly add more and train each for field usage.

I hope you get that it is not just asking an array of questions interview style. But it is asking good questions across the whole seduction, seeing her. It is responding to her leads with stimulation, it is giving yourself on select areas which will make her mirror that too. As well as another conversational enhancing tech. It’s getting into inside game with her.

With Initial elicitation all of the stimulation becomes stronger because you’re now responding to HER world and what matters to her. The stuff you elicit you pace out and lead further through the above. The elicitation is the central steering tool that enables the stimulation which is why the focus in this post is on that.

Once you add elicitation into the pool of techs, many aspects of the seduction change. e.g., on opening, all you really need is to get in with the opener, which I wrote about before. This means that the opening game becomes a very different ballgame than what’s usually depicted in seduction circles. From there you elicit things out through good questioning or baits (e.g. giving i tech that she mirrors).

Also elicitation is a route into so-called inside game, where you are on the inside with her on things in a deeper rapport and perceived understanding. It changes many things across the seductive process.

In marketing & sales, elicitation is what makes or breaks if receivers respond or not. It removes blindness.

 

Some Keys to Getting Elicitation Working for You

Be genuinely curious. This provides a better feel to it for yourself and is a very harmonic vibe on the emphatic sides of things.

Ground yourself when asking. Get your focus down in your body and sort of collect yourself inside your skin; this increases harmony.

Assume interestingness with her (Juggler). This will make you dig out good things and have an acknowledging addition to your vibe.

Once internalised its just one of several routes in your verbal game. I use it a lot. Others less. It’s all down to one’s style and balance.

This is more of an advanced topic in my opinion, and has immense potential if utilised with care and continued effort. It is covert power, use of stealth, low keyness. Its smooth operating. Once you get it down it can drive things in so many directions and be used alongside other techs. It’s highly adaptive and a powerful way to make vibes, frame acts, and alike deeply impactful and adapted to her world.

+ This is a strong way to add to the seduction, for creatively creating a really good experience for her. As well as ourselves.

A key for me is that it makes it more alive for me as I figure her out and riff of her sayings, give my own and create a satisfying conversation by steering it into what actually attracts me. This awakens the right things which makes the feel of the thing invigorating and alive.

Shoot me your thoughts – I think sharing practices of elicitation together could be a good place to enhance some more serious things.

 

About the Author: Glow

	

Glow is a creative and thoughtful senior seducer who’s been a member of the Skilled Seducer Forum since joining from the now-defunct nextASF. He’s known for his insightful posts on seductive tactics and strategy.
